tt_yolgen_10.m: I don't understand ... What are you talking about?

yolgen_1.m: Oh, that is a long story my friend. This town has existed for ages and it used to be a prosperous and well visited outpost on the border of the Aewhata Kingdom. We used to trade with Fallhaven and Prim.

yolgen_1a.m: Stoutford used to be the seat of Lord Erwyn of house Gorland. But during the Noble Wars 17 years ago, everything changed.

yolgen_2.m: Well, the Noble Wars were one of the darkest periods of our history. They lasted only 3 years but brought great misery to most of the area.

yolgen_2a.m: When our great King Luthor died and left the throne with no heir the three mighty lords of the land soon enough began fighting over the title as successor. They were Lord Erwyn of Stoutford, Lord Geomyr of Feygard, who used to be the advisor to King Luthor, and Lord Emeric of Nor City. The former capital of Fallhaven at first remained neutral.

yolgen_3.m: While Erwyn and Emeric fought to capture the central area, Lord Geomyr waited for the right moment and crushed his enemies with his great army. He has ruled the Kingdom ever since with an iron hand.
r: Why do you say iron hand?

yolgen_4.m: Well, he has installed garrisons in pretty much every village, introduced a tax system and now he even wants to prohibit the worship of the mighty Shadow! This is outrageous!
r: I will clear the castle of undead for you.

yolgen_4a.m: Yes, incredible! Although kids like you should not play with such things.
r: I will clear the castle of undead for you.

yolgen_castle_0.m: We do have a problem. Our soldiers usually guard the castle gate to Mt. Galmore to keep the monsters away from the Kingdom.

yolgen_castle_0_1.m: Before you leave, go to Tahalendor. He might give you something that helps against undead.
r: There was something else I wanted to ask you about.

yolgen_castle_0a.m: However, five days ago, the undead knights of Lord Erwyn started to rise from their grave. I have no idea why this happened. We haven't been able to recapture the castle yet. I would ask you to rid us of this plague.
r: It sounds more like a task for the guards. I'll go and talk to the captain of the guard.
No problem. They are already as good as dead.
Hmm, I wonder where they came from.
No thanks. I think that's way over my head.

yolgen_castle_10.m: He was there without any of his ... special items? Did you look thoroughly?
r: [Lie] Yes, but I found nothing worth having.
I found a strange glowing ring. But I prefer to keep it. You have enough such toys, I am sure.
Yes, indeed, look at this ring.

yolgen_castle_11.m: If you say so. I suspect Lord Erwyn had a ring, and if you find it you must bring it to me. It is dangerous.
r: Thank you for the warning. I wonder who had owned the ring before Erwyn.

yolgen_castle_12.m: You're insane! Lord Erwyn's ring is dangerous. It must be destroyed!
r: No, I don't think so. I wonder who had owned the ring before Erwyn?
You are probably right. Here is the ring.

yolgen_castle_13.m: Do not play with ancient forces that are beyond your power.
r: Now I'm even more curious who the ring belonged to. Farewell, Yolgen.

yolgen_castle_1_1a.m: Let me see... OK, you killed all of the undead knights and soldiers who had worn Lord Erwyn's tattered banner.

yolgen_castle_1_1b.m: Let me see... You already killed some of Erwyn's undead knights and soldiers - if killed is the correct word for undead. But there are some still around.
r: OK, I will go and look for the rest.

yolgen_castle_1_1c.m: Let me see... No, the castle is still crowded with undead soldiers.

yolgen_castle_1_1d.m: I just know. Don't try to fool me.

yolgen_castle_1_2a.m: And you slew Lord Erwyn's commander.

yolgen_castle_1_2b.m: But their commander is still around.
r: OK, I will go and look for him.

yolgen_castle_1_3a.m: And you slew Lord Erwyn himself.

yolgen_castle_1_3b.m: But Lord Erwyn is still around.
r: OK, I will go and look for him.
Well, it was a tough fight, but I managed to slay Lord Erwyn himself.
The undead are no match for me.
Sure. I found this ring among his remains.
[Lie] He had nothing of any worth on him.

yolgen_castle_3.m: I am very pleased to hear this. A ring you say? Let me take a look.

yolgen_castle_4.m: Hmm. This looks most interesting. I suspected something like this. It is certainly some magical item and seems to have the powers to reanimate the dead. I am indeed very grateful that you brought this ring to me. We should destroy it once and for all to avoid further trouble.
r: Sounds fine to me. Anything for the safety of the people of Stoutford.

yolgen_castle_5.m: Yolgen puts the ring on his altar and chants a spell. Suddenly the altar seems to be getting darker and darker and then the ring cracks.

yolgen_castle_6.m: That is it. The ring is destroyed. I wonder where it came from. Maybe from the depths of Mt. Galmore, or some mischievous traveller put it on Lord Erwyn's remains? Anyway, my friend, I and the people of Stoutford are most grateful.
r: Thank you. Shadow be with you.

yolgen_flagstone_0.m: If you could help with Flagstone, it would take a big burden off us.
r: I have been inside Flagstone, but I will go back and find out more.
OK, I will take a look.

yolgen_flagstone_10.m: Oh that is good news! I am very pleased that the citizens of Stoutford have one thing less to worry about. It is a pity that we didn't send guards to investigate the prison earlier. Then all of this wouldn't have happened. Here, take this gold.
r: Thank you kindly. I am happy to help.
Thank you kindly. Shadow be with you.
Tahalendor told me that you may have items to trade.
What can you tell me about the area around here?
I have dealt with Erwyn's army.
I cleared Flagstone of an evil demon.
Is there anything I can do to help?
I need some help finding out who is responsible for casting a Shadow spell that causes a person to become noticeable.

yolgen_rumblings10_0.m: Walk in the shadow kid. I have to apologize for my master, Tahalendor.
r: Crazy old geezer... What's wrong with him?
Let us talk about something different.

yolgen_rumblings10_1.m: My master is wise and old, but his sight is not as sharp as it once was. He took you for someone else.

yolgen_rumblings10_2.m: To his credit, I have to admit you do look a bit like him. I don't know his name.
r: That must be my brother Andor!

yolgen_rumblings10_3.m: He came around here not long ago, with a shady looking travelling companion. He stayed a couple of days from what I heard. Since then, we have been hearing frequent rumbles in the church, coming from underground.

yolgen_rumblings10_4.m: It can be so loud as to make the whole church shake. It has even damaged the walls and the roof.

yolgen_rumblings10_5.m: This church is the refuge for all the villagers when monsters attack. We are really worried now.
r: I can't believe Andor has anything to do with this. Can you tell me more?
Is there anything I can do to help?
Whatever... It's none of my business.

yolgen_rumblings10_6.m: I told you all I know. Maybe others in town have seen him.
r: Guess I'll have to look into it.

yolgen_rumblings20_0.m: Hello again. Have you found anything about what is causing the noises in the church?
r: Let us talk about something different.

yolgen_rumblings50_0.m: Hello again. Have you found anything about what is causing the noises in the church? It seems they have stopped.
r: Yes. I think I found the cause.
Let us talk about something different.

yolgen_rumblings50_1.m: Great. You should talk to my master. I told him you were not who he thought you were.

yolgen_surroundings_0.m: Well, to the east, there's Flagstone prison. To the south, there's Mt. Galmore. That's definitely a place that you don't want to go to. To the northwest, we have our railway terminal, and going west beyond that, you come to our border post at the Blackwater river. Nothing but bogs and marshes westwards of that. And finally, to the north, we had a tunnel leading to Prim and the Elm mine, in the heart of Blackwater mountain.
r: Can you tell me more about Flagstone?
Can you tell me more about Mt. Galmore?
Can you tell me more about the railway terminal northwest of here?
Can you tell me more about Blackwater mountain?
There is something else I wanted to know.

yolgen_surroundings_1.m: Flagstone Prison was built four hundred years ago by house Gorland of Stoutford, and was used until the Noble Wars, when the house was vanquished by its enemies. They mostly used it to detain people that were worshipping the "old gods".

yolgen_surroundings_1a.m: That dreadful place has been left abandoned ever since. Recently, however, undead have started pouring out of the prison, and we had to send guards to keep them away from the road.
r: Can I help you with Flagstone?
Is there anything I could help you with?
There was something else I wanted to ask you about.

yolgen_surroundings_2.m: Mt. Galmore? It has been our bane for a long time. Garthan I, the founder of Aewhata Kingdom, ordered the excavation of the mountain for gold and gems 430 years ago.

yolgen_surroundings_2a.m: Local lore says that fortifications were built to protect against monster attacks, and an enormous network of mine tunnels was dug under the mountain. They found rich ore veins and the mine flourished.

yolgen_surroundings_2b.m: But their success didn't last long. It is said that after a few years unspeakable horrors overwhelmed the knights and miners of the King, and the mine has been abandoned ever since.

yolgen_surroundings_2c.m: However, recently more and more of the most foul monsters are coming from the mountain and we have to fend them off. There are rumors that the mines are once gain being worked. If true, that is very foolish, and dangerous. With the rise of undead knights in the castle and Lord Erwyn's demise we struggle more and more.
r: That sounds dreadful. Can I help you with the castle?
Is there anything I could do to help?
There was something else I wanted to ask you about.

yolgen_surroundings_3.m: As I said, we've got our railway terminal to the west.

yolgen_surroundings_3a.m: We used to trade food and tools with Prim and the miners from Elm mine and get loads of iron ingots in return. We shipped them on to Nor City and Feygard and prospered from the trade.

yolgen_surroundings_3b.m: Further to the west, there's the border outpost next to Blackwater River. Anyway, from what I have heard there's nothing but bogs, marshes and grasslands west of the river, along with a few native tribes.
r: Is there anything I could do to help?
There was something else I wanted to ask you about.

yolgen_surroundings_4.m: Ah. Blackwater mountain. I will try to keep a long story short. We used to trade food and tools with Prim and the miners from Elm mine, and get loads of iron ingots in return. We shipped them on to Nor City and Feygard and prospered from the trade.

yolgen_surroundings_5.m: A few months ago, everything changed. A sudden violent earthquake shook the mountain and our railway tunnel to Prim collapsed.

yolgen_surroundings_5a.m: At almost the same time, those Gornaud beasts attacked us, and with all the trouble we're having we haven't been able to restore the tunnel yet.

yolgen_surroundings_5b.m: There hasn't been any contact with Prim since then, so we no longer have any trade with them. That means there are also fewer travellers coming from Fallhaven and Nor City. It's a shame.
r: Is there anything I can help with?
There was something else I wanted to ask you about.

yolgen_surroundings_flagstone_4.m: Yes, thanks to you my friend, we don't need to worry about the undead anymore.
r: There was something else I wanted to ask you about.
Where do you think they came from?

yolgen_task_0_1.m: Well, you already were of great help. Thank you again!

yolgen_task_0_2.m: Well, you look a bit young. But I guess we could still make use of you in these dark times. Let me think about some tasks I can offer you.
r: What about the undead in the castle?
OK. I will go to the prison.
I cleared Flagstone of an evil demon.
Sure. All the undead will soon be dead!

troubling_times.10: I went to the Thieves' Guild in Fallhaven looking for things to do.
troubling_times.20: Since I had helped Defy, Umar and Nanath threw me out. I cannot enter the basement again.
troubling_times.30: Since I had looted the Thieves' Guild vault after killing Defy, Umar and Nanath threw me out. I cannot enter the basement again.
troubling_times.40: I met Nanath, who's scared and upset, because someone put a spell on all members of the Thieves' Guild. This spell made all thieves noticeable. He asked me if I could help dispel the spell.
troubling_times.50: Nanath told me to find the Shadow priest who had cast the spell on the Guild.
troubling_times.60: I set out interviewing Shadow priests to find who had cast the spell.
troubling_times.70: Talion, Shadow priest of Loneford, had cast the Striking Spectacle Shadow spell on the Guild, on payment from Dameni, a mysterious lady leading a band of toughs
troubling_times.80: Talion could dispel the spell, using a few items - Villain's ring, Troublemaker's ring, ring of backstabbing, Tears of the Shadow potion, Luthor's ring.  He also wanted 50000 gold.
troubling_times.82: I have informed Nanath about the Striking Spectacle Shadow spell and Talion's demands.
troubling_times.90: Nanath told me Thieves' Guild would give me the 50000 gold back when I have got the spell dispelled.
troubling_times.95: Nanath asked if I had already found Luthor's ring.
troubling_times.100: I went back to Nanath as I couldn't find Luthor's ring anywhere.
troubling_times.105: He told me to seek out Fanamor's friend Sly Seraphina near the Sutdover bridge.
troubling_times.110: Seraphina didn't believe me. She told me to go away.
troubling_times.115: Nanath sent me to Umar. He should make sure Sly carries out the order.
troubling_times.120: Umar told me one of his secret passwords to convince Seraphina.
troubling_times.130: Sly Seraphina said that Luthor's ring was to be found in the cave which Crackshot tried to open. The door was sealed by Umar and Seraphina to prevent monsters in that cave from devastating Dhayavar. The sealing was done by using Luthor's items. She and Umar decided to separate them, and keep them separate.
troubling_times.140: Seraphina felt that the danger was too high to open that door. So she disappeared.
troubling_times.150: I had to find Sly Seraphina again.
troubling_times.160: Nanath told me to look for her in her usual hiding places: Near one of the towns Sullengard, Stoutford, Vilegard, Prim, Loneford, or Brimhaven.
troubling_times.170: Talion said that without the items he asked for he couldn't help. I had to find Seraphina.
troubling_times.180: After beating the tough guys protecting Seraphina, she was convinced that I was strong enough to help her beat the monsters in the cave.
troubling_times.190: Seraphina gave me back the money she had stolen from me earlier.
troubling_times.192: I have to ask Umar for Luthor's key.
troubling_times.195: Seraphina agreed to help me and told me to meet her at the locked door in the cave where Crackshot was defeated.
troubling_times.200: I met Seraphina at the cave door where Crackshot was defeated.
troubling_times.210: Seraphina could open the door with Luthor's key wearing also his gloves. She entered the cave behind the door.
troubling_times.230: Seraphina got injured attacking one of the monsters.
troubling_times.240: I have killed the monsters blocking the entrance.
troubling_times.252: I tried to poison Seraphina, but she noticed in time. At least she didn't notice that I did it on purpose.
troubling_times.255: Seraphina already started the search for the ring.
troubling_times.260: I searched the cave for Luthor's ring. I couldn't find it.
troubling_times.270: Sly Seraphina had found the ring. She gave it to me and told me to keep it safe. She disappeared again, probably back to Sutdover bridge. I had to go to Talion.
troubling_times.280: I gave 50000 gold, Villain's ring, Troublemaker's ring, ring of backstabbing, Tears of the Shadow potion, and Luthor's ring to Talion.
troubling_times.290: Talion used them to undo the spell.
troubling_times.300: Talion returned Luthor's ring. The other rings were broken in the process though and the Tears of the Shadow potion was used up of course.
troubling_times.302: The room with the dangerous creatures has been locked and sealed again.
troubling_times.310: Nanath gave me 75000 gold as a reward for a job well done.
troubling_times.320: Sly Seraphina was friendly to me - for now.

andor.1: My father Mikhail says that Andor has not been home since yesterday. I should go look for him in the village.
andor.10: Leonid tells me that he saw Andor talking to Gruil. I should go ask Gruil if he knows more.
andor.20: Gruil wants me to bring him a poison gland. Then he might talk more. He tells me that some poisonous snakes have such a gland.
andor.30: Gruil tells me that Andor was looking for someone called Umar. I should go ask his friend Gaela in Fallhaven to the east.
andor.40: I talked to Gaela in Fallhaven. He tells me to go see Bucus and ask about the Thieves' Guild.
andor.50: Bucus has allowed me to enter the hatch in the derelict house in Fallhaven. I should go talk to Umar.
andor.51: Umar in the Fallhaven Thieves' Guild recognized me, but must have me confused with Andor. Apparently, Andor has been to see him.
andor.55: Umar told me that Andor went to see a potion maker called Lodar. I should search for his hideaway.
andor.61: I heard a story in Loneford, where it seemed like Andor had been in Loneford, and that he might have had something to do with the illness that the people are suffering from there. I am not sure if it actually was Andor. If it was Andor, why would he have made the people of Loneford ill?
andor.62: Andor might have gone to do some business with a rich man in Brimhaven after he left Loneford.
andor.65: It looks like Andor was involved in the destruction of the Brimhaven dam.
andor.70: I have found the potion-maker Lodar, and heard his story about Andor. Andor went to visit Lodar in his hideaway to get a sample of something called Narwood extract. Lodar happened to notice that there was someone travelling together with Andor, that hid among the trees and did not seem to want Lodar to spot him.
andor.71: Shortly after Andor and the person he was travelling with had left, strange things started to happen in the woods around Lodar's hideaway, and Lodar himself seemed to be affected by it somehow. Lodar believes that something disturbed the tomb below his cabin, and awoke the Hira'zinn.
andor.72: Since I helped Lodar defeat the Hira'zinn, he promised to help me in return. He gave me a piece of paper that should allow me to enter the Valanyr temple of the Shadow in Nor City. He told me to seek out lady Lydalon in the temple for further assistance.
andor.80: All clues so far as to where Andor went point to Nor City. I should travel to Nor City by following the Duleian road to the southeast and look for more clues there.
andor.85: Andor may have been in Stoutford.
andor.86: Andor had something to do with the demon under the church in Stoutford.
andor.90: At Castle Guynmart I learned from Steward Unkorh that some time ago Andor was also there as a guest.
andor.92: Unkorh gave me the bonemeal potion box that Andor had given him for safekeeping.
andor.100: While exploring the town of Sullengard, I so happened to stumble upon my mother and my aunt to whom I have never met. Mother has insisted that I go home so we can talk.
andor.110: After talking with mother back at home, she and I tried to brainstorm about where Andor could be. She reminded me about Andor's friend Stanwick who lives in Brightport. We agreed that going to talk to him might be the next logical thing to do.
andor.120: In the dungeons of Laeroth manor, Kotheses, the torturer, mentioned that he had taught Andor the basics of torturing.
andor.125: Vaelric confirmed that Andor visited him recently. Andor sought to learn Vaelric's skills and left quickly, clutching what he came for. His actions raise more questions about his intentions.
andor.126: In Brightport, I was finally able to meet Stanwick, but due to his hazy memory, he was not able to help me learn anything about the whereabouts of Andor.
andor.127: Regaining his peace of mind after I helped him, Stanwick said he'll tell me more about Andor, once he gathers his thoughts.
andor.128: Stanwick gave me a signet ring that I should show to his father. Jorwick, in Nor City.
andor.130: Andor was trying to find out from Seraphina about terrible monsters in the hideout near the place with the larval burrowers.
andor.131: Elysa in the Brightport's thieves guild told me that Andor has bought a map to the sewers of Feygard.
andor.132: While investigating the Brightport theft I learned from Bryma that Andor was the one who stole the important document, and brought it to her in exchange for her alchemy knowledge.
andor.140: I saw Andor in the mountains of Galmore. We were able to exchange a few words before he disappeared again.
andor.145: I met Andor on the road to Feygard, where he was buying food from Rosmara. He disappeared again.
andor.147: I met Andor on the road to Nor City, where he was buying supplies from Alynndir. He disappeared again.
andor.910: I decided to settle down on the top of Mt. Galmore. For this I needed to find a rich and discreet man to rebuild the ruins according to my wishes. Andor will now have to go and find himself.
andor.912: The construction contract for my new home was completed. I was curious to see what it would look like.
andor.914: I visited my new residence on the top of Mt. Galmore. There I would help the people of Dhayavar as a hero and protect them from villains. Or would I become a villain myself? We'll see.
andor.999: [Quest is not completable at this time.]

flagstone.5: Yolgen asked me to have a look at what is wrong with Flagstone prison.
flagstone.10: I met a guard from Stoutford on sentry duty outside a fortress called Flagstone. He told me that Flagstone used to serve as a prison for house Gorland of Stoutford, but it is now abandoned. Recently, undead have started pouring out of Flagstone. I should investigate the source of the undead monsters. The guard tells me to return to him if I need help.
flagstone.20: I found a dug out tunnel beneath Flagstone, that seems to lead to a larger cave. The cave is guarded by a demon that I am not even able to approach. Maybe the guard outside Flagstone knows more?
flagstone.30: The guard suggested that the former warden may have something to do with this, and I should go and look for him. If I find him I should return to the guard with any important news.
flagstone.31: I found the former warden of Flagstone on the upper level. Among his remains I found a necklace with some inscriptions. I should return to the guard now.
flagstone.40: I have learned the words required to approach the demon beneath Flagstone. 'Daylight Shadow'. It seems like the warden has something to do with the monster invasion.
flagstone.50: Deep beneath Flagstone, I found a powerful winged demon. It seems like the warden kept on running the prison and experimented with necromancy.
flagstone.60: I found one prisoner, Narael, alive deep beneath Flagstone. Narael was once a citizen of Nor City. He is too weak to walk by himself, but if I can find his wife in Nor City, I would be handsomely rewarded.
flagstone.70: I approached the sentry again and he was happy to hear the source of the undead is gone. I should talk to Yolgen, the priest of Stoutford, for a reward.
flagstone.100: Yolgen rewarded me handsomely for my efforts and is happy that there is one thing less the citizens of Stoutford have to worry about.

stoutford_castle.5: I tried to free this castle from the undead Lord Erwyn. But whenever I kill him, he reappears. I should seek help...
stoutford_castle.10: I talked to Yolgen, the Shadow priest of Stoutford, and he told me that the mighty Lord Erwyn used to reside here, but Lord Erwyn and his army were crushed during a war, the castle was sacked and the house extinguished. But recently Erwyn's knights have risen from the dead. Yolgen asked me to rid Stoutford of these undead once and for all.
stoutford_castle.12: I should ask Tahalendor for some special artifact that I can use to defeat powerful undead.
stoutford_castle.14: Tahalendor gave me a pair of special coins that I can use to defeat powerful undead.
stoutford_castle.16: I slew Lord Erwyn himself and ensured that he remains dead now.
stoutford_castle.20: I slew all the undead knights.
stoutford_castle.42: Among his remains I found a strange ring. I should show it to Yolgen.
stoutford_castle.50: Yolgen examined the ring thoroughly. He suspects it has somehow come from Mt. Galmore and reanimated the long dead soldiers. I should be wary of the evil grasp of Mt. Galmore and whatever lurks there...
stoutford_castle.60: I kept the ring for myself, which upset Yolgen. I should keep looking for its previous owner.
stoutford_castle.70: I kept the ring for myself and didn't tell Yolgen about it. He was suspicious but couldn't do anything about it. I should keep looking for its previous owner.

rumblings.10: The priest in Stoutford looks scared of me and of what I did, but we never met before. Can this have something to do with Andor?
rumblings.20: The priest's acolyte, Yolgen, told me that Andor was here a while ago, and since then, scary noises resonate in the church, seemingly coming from underground.
rumblings.25: A member of the Thieve's Guild in the tavern of Stoutford told me that the tavern owner dealt with Andor.
rumblings.30: Glasforn, the owner of the tavern of Stoutford, admits to knowing Andor, but evades all my questions by boasting about his beds' quality.
rumblings.50: After sleeping in Glasforn's bed, I woke up in a cave, and was attacked by a monster. I killed it, but I should go see Glasforn again.
rumblings.60: When Glasforn saw me, he was really scared. Hopefully I'll get some information from him.
rumblings.70: I confronted Glasforn. He admited everything, but blamed Andor for it. How can Andor be involved in this?
rumblings.80: Yolgen told me the rumbles have stopped. I should talk to the priest.
rumblings.85: The priest told me the monster was a lich. I should keep its heart safe.
rumblings.90: The priest thanked me for saving his church and asked who the culprit was.
rumblings.100: I told him I do not know who was responsible.
rumblings.103: I told him Glasforn was responsible.
rumblings.106: I told him Andor was responsible.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
